contract.store: Explicit context VariableStore, declared globals take precedence
contract.creation: Portable resource-free types and attached user declarations; contiguous inner/middle/outer dimensions; unknown/unsupported forms return status before allocation
contract.rename: Preserve binding identity, values, metadata and entry caches; protect compiled globals, attached namespaces and system paths
contract.byname: Direct typed user routine argument only; exact formal-compatible alias; calling-root default; disjoint entry; no system/protected paths or active FOR aliasing
contract.persistence: Typed values plus optional creation group and memory_pool metadata; reject duplicate rows; validate creation limits before array decode
